description: Assigns a label sl to history sn . During plotting, this label will appear instead of the default label. If you wish to use the original label again, assign an empty string (“ ”).
notes: 6.0 does not have this command: use history name <sn> label <sl> there (that spelling stays live on every version).
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-10 on the PFC 7.00/9.8 consoles (2D & 3D) (state grade): the assigned label appears in the history list Label column; rejected on 6.00 (the 6.00 history keyword set has no label).
